item.title: LOT-123: art of the seven alternate icons
item.body:
LOT-123
Refs #214
Claim: mac/lot-123-art

The art and licence half of LOT-123; the code (wiring, picker, haptics, spec) is in the cloud PR of `ext/francoisgn-lot-123`. No Swift and no project change here.

**Problem.** The seven alternates were flat PNGs, and five stop at 180 px, so they are soft on the 1024 canvas of a `.icon`. The operator wants nothing blurry: reuse an image of sufficient resolution, redo any other.

**Final names** (stable; the cloud code refers to these)

| Icon | What | Source and licence |
|---|---|---|
| `Icon-CLASSIC` | Redone | Own SVG, drawn from geometry measured on the legacy pixels. No AI, no upscaling. Repository licence; design credited to its legacy author in CREDITS.md |
| `Icon-CLASSIC-RED` | Redone | Same |
| `Icon-REDFACE` | Redone | Same |
| `Icon-REDFACEBLUE` | Redone | Same |
| `Icon-BETA` | Redone | Same; the hand-drawn stroke is retraced as smooth Bézier strokes |
| `Icon-BLUE` | Reused | Legacy 1024 px PNG, unchanged, credited in `CREDITS.md` |
| `Icon-WHITE` | Reused | Same. Its orange is duller than the 180 px PNG's: legacy's own largest file, kept unchanged |

`Icon-RedFace3D` and `Icon-RedFace3DBig` keep their names and are not touched. The legacy repository has no root licence file: the reused art follows #580, copied and credited, on the operator's decision.

**Checked.** All seven viewed at 1024 next to the legacy icon: sharp. With `ictool`, clear and tinted derive from the art; `Dark` equals `Default` on all seven, the operator's option A. `actool` compiled the `.icon` documents as alternates (Xcode 27.2).

**Not checked.** A real `setAlternateIconName`: the run stopped when the code moved to the cloud. That is part of the Mac check once both PRs land.

**Left to do.**
- Cloud: `ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_ALTERNATE_APPICON_NAMES` in both configs of `project.pbxproj`, tab-indented: without it the app declares no alternate. This PR adds the art only, so nothing uses it yet.
- `Icon-RedFace3DBig` has a 500 px layer. Not redone here, to be judged in the Mac check.
- Mac check after both PRs: rendering in the picker and on the home screen (light, dark, tinted), haptics on and off on a device.

### Ledger

```changelog
| UX | Sept icônes alternatives en .icon, cinq redessinées en vectoriel pour rester nettes (LOT-123) | #623 | `SuperHFRplus/Assets/AlternativeIcons/` @ 2440d79 |
```

```gap-edit
GAP-148
H.1: b·operator
SwiftHFR final: Picker of 9 options (the 8 legacy values on their legacy keys and names, plus REDFACE 3D Big) on a screen behind the "Icône" row; the key is written only after the system accepted the switch (#622). Five of the legacy icons are redrawn as SVG at full resolution (#623).
```

comments.body: Done: #623 is ready for review, and its `### Ledger` section is in the rule #620 blocks: one `changelog` block with the row cells in the CHANGELOG-LEGACY column order (Section, Résumé, Lot / PR, Preuve legacy), no number, and one `gap-edit` block for GAP-148. Label `ledger` kept. Head: 4f3370cd. Ready for your adversarial review (art provenance + CREDITS).

**Adversarial review (Fable) — REQUEST CHANGES at 4f3370c**

Scope: the seven `.icon` bundles and `CREDITS.md` only, against `SuperHFRplus/Assets/AlternativeIcons/` @ `2440d79`, PR #622's names, rule #620 and CI. Verdict: the art is right; one credit cell is not. One docs-only commit (finding 1, optionally 2 and 4) and I approve.

### Findings

1. **Medium — `CREDITS.md:24`, "None needed" for the five redrawn icons.** The SVGs are faithful re-vectorisations, not new designs: rasterised over their `icon.json` fills and compared with the legacy `@3x` PNGs at 180 px, the mean channel difference is 0.6 (BETA), 1.0 (CLASSIC), 1.3 (CLASSIC-RED), 2.0 (REDFACE), 3.5 (REDFACEBLUE) out of 255. The designs have authors in the legacy history: FLKone for `CLASSIC`, `REDFACE` and `BETA` (`2e6b2d8`, `9e68d54`, 2017-11-01; `Icon-REDFACE@2x/3x` are renames of the original `Images.xcassets/ClassicIcon.appiconset` app icon), Bruno/ezzz for `CLASSIC-RED` and `REDFACE-BLUE` (`f96e269`, 2025-05-03). *Failing scenario:* a reader of `CREDITS.md` concludes the HFR+ authors drew nothing in these five icons, which the repository's own "credit the authors" rule (PolyForm NC, `CREDITS.md`) and #580 §3 contradict. *Fix:* replace the cell with something like "Design: FLKone and the HFR+ contributors (`CLASSIC`, `REDFACE`, `BETA`), ezzz and the HFRnow contributors (`CLASSIC-RED`, `REDFACEBLUE`); redrawn as SVG for SwiftHFR, repository licence", and drop "no credit needed" from the PR body table.

2. **Low — `App/SwiftHFR/Icon-BETA.icon/Assets/foreground.svg`: opaque `<rect width="180" height="180" fill="#fff"/>` inside the foreground layer.** It duplicates the white `fill-specializations` of `icon.json` and makes the layer opaque, so the Clear and Tinted renditions show a white slab where the system glass should be; `REDFACE` and `REDFACEBLUE` are strokes only and will render as intended. (`CLASSIC`'s white sheet with stripe holes is the design itself, fine.) *Failing scenario:* the Mac check in Clear or Tinted mode shows BETA as a flat white square. *Fix:* delete the `<rect>`; the background already comes from `icon.json`.

3. **Low — PR body `### Ledger`, `gap-edit` block: `Notes:` is not a GAP column.** `tooling/docs/ledger.py check-body` from #621's head rejects it: `ERROR gap-edit block 2: "Notes: five icons redrawn at full resolution (#623": expected <Column>: <text>, Column one of Feature, Legacy behaviour, Legacy ref, SwiftHFR final, Lot/Feat, Gap, Source, H.1`. The `changelog` block parses and the `H.1: b·operator` cell is accepted (the partial-cells form #621 adds). *Failing scenario:* the steward's batch cannot apply the GAP-148 edit. *Fix (body only, no push):* `SwiftHFR final: Same picker; five icons redrawn as vectors at full resolution (#623)` instead of the `Notes:` line.

4. **Low — `CREDITS.md`: `Icon-RedFace3DBig` is credited twice** (the "App icon" paragraph at line 14 and the new table row), and the paragraph still calls it "unwired", which #622 makes false. *Fix:* let the table own every alternate and keep the paragraph for the main icon; can ride with the finding-1 commit.

### Verified, no action

- **Provenance.** `Icon-BLUE_1024.png` and `Icon-WHITE_1024.png` are byte-identical to the legacy blobs (`0f5ed4d6`, `8cafdf84`; added by ezzz in `6aa10e5`, 2018-11-10; Aynolor's `ec41abd` retouched only the 60/120/180 files, so the row's credit is right). They carry only a `dpi` chunk: no XMP, ICC or EXIF. The five SVGs contain only `path`, `circle` and one `rect`: no `<image>`, `data:` URI, metadata or editor string. The same design as the 180 px siblings (checked side by side). No embedded third-party art, no person's likeness (a smiley and the HFR wordmark, both in the legacy app since 2017–2018). The legacy repository has no licence file at `2440d79` (root holds `README.md` only); #580 §3 governs the reuse and the table follows it.
- **Names.** The seven bundles equal the legacy `CFBundleAlternateIcons` keys (`HFRswift/Info.plist:19-77`; `Icon-REDFACEBLUE` is the key, `Icon-REDFACE-BLUE` was only the file) and #622's `AppIconOption.alternateIconName` (`AppIconSettingsModel.swift:66-73`) and `ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_ALTERNATE_APPICON_NAMES` (both configurations, 8 names); every listed alternate exists on this tree (`Icon-RedFace3DBig` from #581). No stray files.
- **Sizes and secrets.** SVG 405 B–5.6 KB, `icon.json` 440 B–1.2 KB, PNG 12,140 and 12,105 B: about 37 KB in all. gitleaks green; nothing resembling a token.
- **Rule #620.** No change to `docs/CHANGELOG-LEGACY.md`, the GAP file or the fragment folders; the diff is the 14 icon files and `CREDITS.md`.
- **`icon.json`.** Same shape as `Icon-RedFace3D.icon` (`supported-platforms: squares: shared`, one group, one layer); Dark equals Default on all seven (option A); the five redrawn declare their fills as gradients or a solid, the two reused ones are a single opaque PNG layer.
- **CI on 4f3370c.** `App build + tests (iOS 27 simulator)` **success** (run 42432535139, 01:03–01:15 UTC): actool received the nine `.icon` documents, `BUILD SUCCEEDED` and `TEST SUCCEEDED`. The 21:03 failure of the same job lasted two seconds: the draft gate (#477), not actool. Pre-commit, SwiftLint, Docs consistency, HFRKit tests, fixture tooling, CodeRabbit, gitleaks all green; `mergeable_state: clean`.

**Adversarial review (Fable) round 2 — APPROVE at ee648cc**

Reviewed `git show ee648cc` only (2 files, +3/−3), the PR body's `### Ledger` and credit line, and CI on this head. All four round-1 findings are fixed; nothing new.

1. **Credit (Medium, fixed).** `CREDITS.md:26` now reads "Legacy designs redrawn as SVG for SwiftHFR … under this repository's licence | Designs by FLKone (`Icon-CLASSIC`, `Icon-REDFACE`, `Icon-BETA`, 2017) and by Bruno / ezzz (`Icon-CLASSIC-RED`, `Icon-REDFACEBLUE`, 2025), in the legacy history". Matches the legacy commits (`2e6b2d8`/`9e68d54` 2017-11-01, `f96e269` 2025-05-03). The body table's "no credit needed" is replaced by "design credited to its legacy author in CREDITS.md".
2. **BETA foreground (Low, fixed).** The new `foreground.svg` equals the old one with the `<rect width="180" height="180" fill="#fff"/>` removed and nothing else changed (byte comparison); four stroke paths remain, renders as transparent red strokes, the white comes from `icon.json`'s fill.
3. **Ledger (Low, fixed).** `tooling/docs/ledger.py check-body` from #621's head (`4c520c3`) on the current body: `ledger body: 2 block(s) ok`. The `gap-edit` block now carries `H.1: b·operator` and `SwiftHFR final: …` for GAP-148.
4. **Duplicate credit (Low, fixed).** The "App icon" paragraph keeps the main icon only and links to `[AlternativeIcons](#alternativeicons)` (anchor resolves to the `### AlternativeIcons` heading); `Icon-RedFace3DBig` is credited once, in the table, and the "unwired" note is gone.

**CI on ee648cc:** `App build + tests (iOS 27 simulator)` success (run 42434875024), CodeRabbit, Pre-commit, SwiftLint, Docs consistency, HFRKit tests (Linux), Fixture tooling, gitleaks, review all success; CodeQL neutral (Swift analysis not requested, per #477). No change to the ledger files (rule #620).

Merge-ready from my side; the Mac check after #622 (picker, Home Screen in light/dark/clear/tinted) stays as the PR says.
